cards.title: Half-filled free-fermion correlation kernel

source_refs.value: C_ij formula in the free-fermion check

checks.reason: The paper prints the infinite half-filled tight-binding kernel and L=10000.
The diagonal limit is 1/2 and even nonzero separations vanish.
The computed transition eigenvalues are particle-hole symmetric and saturate near 0 and 1.

cards.numerical_form: Construct the real symmetric Toeplitz matrix from its first column and diagonalize the 96 central eigenvalues.

cards.title: Charge-resolved moments and Fourier projection

checks.reason: The charged moment and Fourier projection are printed explicitly.
For independent fermion modes, polynomial convolution is exactly the Fourier coefficient extraction.
Resolved probabilities sum to one and resolved entropy contributions sum to the mode entropy.

cards.numerical_form: Convolve each mode's empty/occupied probabilities while propagating -p log p entropy weights by charge.

cards.title: CFT charge distribution and resolved entropy

checks.reason: The charged-moment scaling and Gaussian sector form are printed in the paper.
Differentiating the Fourier-projected moment at n=1 gives the resolved entropy contribution.
The analytic curves are even in Delta N and agree with the independent lattice calculation over all 11 displayed charges.

cards.numerical_form: Use K=1, sigma^2=[ln(2L)+gamma_E+1]/pi^2 and the known free-fermion entropy constant, without fitting.

cards.title: Free-fermion many-body entanglement spectrum

source_refs.value: free-fermion product spectrum before Main Fig. 2

checks.reason: The Gaussian product spectrum and the 24-mode construction are stated explicitly.
Enumerating binary occupations gives every many-body eigenvalue and its charge sector.
The sector onset grows monotonically with absolute Delta N, consistent with the printed Delta N squared cost.

cards.numerical_form: Enumerate all 2^24 occupations of the closest-to-zero entanglement modes and rank eigenvalues in sectors Delta N=0...5.

cards.title: Charge-resolved integrated spectrum

checks.reason: The Bessel-integral formula and r(alpha) are printed as Main Eq. (11).
Summing all charge sectors reduces to I0(x), the Calabrese-Lefevre all-sector curve.
Gauss-Legendre quadrature reproduces the all-sector I0 curve to 1.2e-13.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the alpha integral with 512-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature on 501 x values.
